option.offscreen-options.idle.label: Idle
option.offscreen-options.idle.hint: Enemies in the extra width walk and animate normally, but will not chase, shoot or hurt you until they reach the original 4:3 screen. You can still hit them.
option.offscreen-options.vanilla.label: Act normally
option.offscreen-options.vanilla.hint: Enemies behave fully everywhere, including chasing, shooting and hurting you from the extra width you can see but the original game could not. Matches the original game.
option.offscreen-options.paused.label: Freeze
option.offscreen-options.paused.hint: Enemies in the extra width stop completely, mid-step, until they reach the original 4:3 screen. No movement, no animation, and no shadow.
option.align-options.center.label: Center
option.align-options.center.hint: The picture fills as much of the screen as it can, centered both ways.
option.align-options.top.label: Top
option.align-options.top.hint: The picture sits against the top edge, leaving the free space below it.
option.align-options.bottom.label: Bottom
option.align-options.bottom.hint: The picture sits against the bottom edge, leaving the free space above it.
option.align-options.left.label: Left
option.align-options.left.hint: The picture sits against the left edge, leaving the free space on the right.
option.align-options.right.label: Right
option.align-options.right.hint: The picture sits against the right edge, leaving the free space on the left.
section.picture.title: Picture
extended-rendering.label: Extended Rendering
extended-rendering.description: Enables widescreen, tall and camera enhancements. Off is fixed 4:3.
linear-world-tilemap.label: Linear World Tilemap
linear-world-tilemap.description: Clean rendering above 19:9. Unlocks the 21:9 wide preset.
linear-world-tilemap.hint: Turning it off drops any ratio wider than 16:9 and switches Ultrawide and Tall off. Needs Extended Rendering.
ultrawide-rendering.label: Ultrawide
ultrawide-rendering.description: Unlocks ratios above 19:9 up to 32:9. Requires Linear World Tilemap.
ultrawide-rendering.hint: Turning it off moves a 32:9 picture back to 21:9.
tall-rendering.label: Tall Rendering
tall-rendering.description: Adds extra rows above and below, which enables tall presets in the picker. Separate from widescreen.
tall-rendering.hint: Turning it off puts a tall picture back to 4:3.
aspect-ratio.label: Aspect Ratio
aspect-ratio.description: Original uses the game width. Wide, Tall, Auto, Screen and Custom use 240 lines.
picture-align.label: Alignment
picture-align.description: Where the picture and its overlays sit when the screen has room to spare, such as a portrait phone with the touch controls below.
extend-y.label: Extend Y
extend-y.description: In Original mode, show 240 lines instead of 224.
widescreen-visual-fixes.label: Widescreen Fixes
widescreen-visual-fixes.description: Corrections for a view wider or taller than the original: transitions, effects and sprites drawn for the 4:3 screen. One switch; on by default.
widescreen-sprites.label: Widescreen Sprites
widescreen-sprites.description: Extend sprite spawn ranges so enemies and objects behave as intended in the wider view.
widescreen-play-area.label: Extend Play Area
widescreen-play-area.description: Extends game activity to the whole widescreen picture: where hazards and enemies spawn and stay active. Off, the extra width you can see stays inactive. Changes gameplay.
offscreen-ai.label: Off-Screen AI
offscreen-ai.description: How enemies in the wide/tall extra band behave before reaching the original screen.
section.performance.title: Performance
display-perf-in-title.label: Show FPS
display-perf-in-title.description: Display the current frames per second, and the refresh rate of your display, in the title bar while the game is running
vsync.label: V-Sync
vsync.description: Paces the game against the display refresh rate instead of an internal timer, which smooths scrolling.
vsync.hint: Game speed stays the same either way.
